hypothesis: Documentation can be kept reviewable and mechanically checked alongside implementation.
intended_mechanism: Versioned maintained-page manifest, schema-derived reference, checked local links, executable example and CI gate.
benchmarks_run: negative probes for missing links, external local paths, fenced examples and schema drift
adversarial_results: Negative probes passed: missing/escaping links rejected; fenced examples ignored; modified schema changes generated output.
cost_results: Local standard-library checks; no network or model calls.
safety_results: Example writes to a temporary workspace and verifies source preservation and both returned artifact hashes.
decision_rationale: Documentation gates and full existing suite pass. No comparative capability or live-provider claim.
reproducibility_notes: Run the documented checker and unittest commands with Python 3.12. CI is configured but has not run remotely.
rollback_trigger: Revert this documentation-workflow commit if the checker, example or existing tests regress.
operator_notes: Link checks cover repository-local inline Markdown targets outside fences; external URLs and fragments are not validated. Historical plans and dated evidence are not maintained-page targets.
